references.label: Monark host's Bolsonaro/COVID controversy
references.evidence: In 2021, Aiub defended former Brazilian President Jair Bolsonaro after he claimed that COVID-19 caused AIDS

references.label: Monark host fired over Nazi party comment
references.evidence: Then in 2022, Aiub was fired from his own show after he got “very drunk” and argued that Brazil should have a Nazi party
